onboarding.title: One more step
onboarding.lead: Choose the username other players will see, then accept the terms.
onboarding.timezoneHint: Your free boosters come back at midnight in this time zone. You can change it in the settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneLead: Your daily limits reset at midnight in this time zone. You can change it once every {days} days.
settings.languageLead: By default, the game uses the language of your device or your country.
settings.themeLead: Cards always keep their true colors.
settings.dangerLead: Deleting your account is immediate and permanent.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.lead: This is permanent: nothing can be recovered.
delete.item1: Your collection, boosters, MemeMoney and trophies will be erased.
delete.item2: Your username will be released and another player may take it.
delete.item3: Purchased MemeMoney will not be refunded.

rarities.title: The 8 rarities
rarities.lead: The rarer a card, the more it shines. Hover over or tap a card to see its effects.

offline.title: No connection
offline.lead: You're offline. Pages you've already visited are still available; everything else comes back as soon as you're online.

boosters.title: Open boosters
boosters.text: {free} free boosters every day, and more to win through challenges. Tear the pack open, flip the {size} cards one by one… and cross your fingers for a Godlevel.

collection.title: Complete your collection
collection.text: Filter by rarity or vibe, sort, search and track your progress. The cards you're missing stay blurred until you find them. The ranking compares every card in the game: popularity, attack, win rate…
collection.rankingHint: 🏆 Ranking: popularity · rarity · HP · attack · speed · win rate

battle.title: Take on the world
battle.text: Build a team of {team} cards and challenge players of your level in real time, all over the planet. {seconds} seconds per turn: every win earns you trophies and MemeMoney.
